name: PMO KCI Status
query: SELECT name AS "KCI:Link/PMO KCI:200", kci_name AS "KCI Name:Data:220", control AS "Control:Link/PMO Control:180", current_value AS "Current:Float:110", threshold AS "Threshold:Float:110", status AS "Status:Data:100", measurement_date AS "Measurement Date:Date:120" FROM `tabPMO KCI` ORDER BY FIELD(status, 'Red','Amber','Green'), kci_name
